name: B10-0250/2026 (Renew) – The cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Indonesia to act. It condemns acid attacks on two activists: Andrie Yunus, a human rights defender attacked in Jakarta in March 2026, and Muhammad Rosidi, an environmental campaigner attacked in February 2026. It asks Indonesia to prosecute everyone involved, try the Yunus case in a civilian court rather than a military one, and protect activists, journalists and trade unions from pressure and violence.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Indonesia to prosecute all those behind both acid attacks.
- Affects Indonesian activists, journalists and unions, plus the military courts handling such cases.
- Next: the EU is urged to raise these cases with Indonesia, including in human rights talks.
